title: MMS convergence matrix tests
objective: Replace the P10-1 MMS matrix stubs with active tests over the planned element/material entries.

plan_assets.asset_description: Phase E6 matrix test acceptance criteria.

scope: Activate MMS matrix tests for planned element and material entries.
Assert fitted convergence rates and useful failure diagnostics.
implementation_steps: Replace pytest.skip coverage in the MMS matrix test.
Parametrize element/material entries through the new MMS matrix API.
Assert convergence rates and structured diagnostics.
Keep local smoke levels separate from nightly/full levels if needed.
Run MMS-specific and existing convergence tests.
acceptance_criteria: Matrix tests are active for planned element/material combinations.
Fitted rates and failure diagnostics are returned in structured convergence results.
risks: Dissipative MMS can be physically ambiguous; mitigate by making the elastic-regime policy explicit unless true manufactured dissipative source terms are implemented.
completion_notes: Replaced the P10-1 MMS matrix skips with active tests.
Matrix tests cover Hex8, Tet10, Hex20, Neo-Hookean, and dissipative elastic-regime policy entries.
Structured diagnostics assert measured rates, thresholds, mesh levels, and material policy notes.
